caption:
For the days your burden feels too heavy

Allah says He does not burden a soul with more than it can bear. Those who believe and do righteous deeds are the people of Paradise, and they will abide there forever.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:42

Who comes to mind when you read this tonight?

#burden #islamichope #surahaaraf #jannah

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
